fullContentHtml:
CPRI Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 110 Assistant, MTS and More Posts - Complete Details

Central Power Research Institute (CPRI) has released the Recruitment 2026 notification for 110 vacancies across various posts. The online application process will be conducted from 19 September 2026 to 12 October 2026. Eligible candidates can apply through the official website, cpri.res.in. The recruitment drive includes Assistant, MTS, Engineering Officer, Technical Attendant and other positions.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 19.09.2026 (10:00 AM)
  • Application Last Date : 12.10.2026 (05:00 PM)
  • Cut-off Date for Age, Qualification and Category : 12.10.2026

Application Fee

  • Posts : Engineering Officer Gr.1 (Electrical/Civil), Engineering Assistant (Electrical/Mechanical), Scientific Assistant, Technician Gr.1 (Electrical/Mechanical), Technical Attendant Gr.1, Assistant Gr. II, Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) Gr.1
  • Application Start Date : 19.09.2026 (10:00 AM)
  • Application Last Date : 12.10.2026 (05:00 PM)
  • Online Registration Opens : 19.09.2026 (10:00 AM)
  • Online Registration Closes : 12.10.2026 (05:00 PM)
  • Post : Essential Qualification & Experience
  • Scientific Assistant : First Class B.Sc. in Chemistry from a recognized university with 5 years of experience in the relevant subject field
  • Engineering Assistant (Electrical) : First Class 3-year Diploma in Engineering/Technology in Electrical with 5 years of experience in the relevant field
  • Engineering Assistant (Mechanical) : First Class 3-year Diploma in Engineering/Technology in Mechanical with 5 years of experience in the relevant field
  • Assistant Gr. II : First Class BA/B.Sc./B.Com/BBA/BBM/BCA degree from a recognized university, along with a minimum Grade-B certificate in the Basic Computer Course (BCC) conducted by NIELIT, valid as on the closing date of application. Only NIELIT BCC certificates are accepted; no other computer course is valid for this post
  • Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) Gr.1 (Watch & Ward Duties) : Matriculation or equivalent from a recognized Board (all posts reserved for Ex-servicemen)
  • Post : Upper Age Limit
  • Scientific Assistant : 35 years
  • Engineering Assistant (Electrical/Mechanical) : 35 years
  • Assistant Gr. II : 30 years
  • Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) Gr.1 : 25 years
  • Post : Pay Level (7th CPC)
  • Engineering Assistant (Electrical/Mechanical) : Level 6
  • Scientific Assistant : Level 6
  • Assistant Gr. II : Level 4
  • Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) Gr.1 : Level 1
  • Post Category : Application Fee (Inclusive of GST)
  • Engineering Officer Gr.1, Scientific Assistant, Engineering Assistant : Rs. 1,000/- per post
  • Technician Gr.1, Assistant Gr. II, Technical Attendant Gr.1 : Rs. 700/- per post
  • Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) Gr.1 : Not separately specified in the notification; all MTS posts are reserved for Ex-servicemen, who are exempt from the application fee
  • Post : Selection Procedure
  • Engineering Assistant (Electrical/Mechanical) : Computer Based Test (CBT) and job-specific practical skill test
  • Scientific Assistant : Computer Based Test (CBT) and job-specific practical skill test
  • Assistant Gr. II : Computer Based Test (CBT) performance
  • Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) Gr.1 : Computer Based Test (CBT) and Trade/Proficiency Test

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
